findings.issue: GET /books/:id/reviews does not check that the book exists, unlike the sibling /books/:id/histogram route added in the same diff which explicitly 404s via Book.getBookById.
findings.evidence: router.get('/books/:id/reviews', ...) calls Stats.getReviewsSorted(bookId, sort) with no existence check; GET /books/99999/reviews or GET /books/abc/reviews (bookId=NaN) returns 200 with [] instead of 404, inconsistent with the histogram route registered right after it.
